text: ふねで　かいがい　りょこう　なんて　ゆうがで　いいよー！

structure.jp: かいがい　りょこう　なんて
structure.en: an overseas trip, of all things

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.span: かいがい　りょこう　なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて holds a thing up to show strong feeling about it, here delight. かいがい　りょこう　なんて = 'travelling overseas, how about that'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing tells you what is used to do something. ふねで = 'by ship'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で after a describing word like ゆうが joins it to the next one, like 'and'. ゆうがで　いい = 'elegant and nice'.
